{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Filter to completed orders only
completed_only = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute conversion rate by segment
conversion_by_segment = completed_only.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].mean()

# Confirm the highest segment
best_segment = conversion_by_segment.idxmax()

# Output the result
print(best_segment)"}
